name: PreQ1 riboswitch bound to PRF (7-aminomethyl-7-deazaguanine analog)
affinitySource: Roth A et al. Nat Struct Mol Biol 2007; ITC data from PMC5749633
notes: PreQ1 class-I riboswitch aptamer domain. Ligand PRF is a synthetic preQ1 analog. Ligand inserts into a preformed pocket and stacks on C15/A14. Phosphate backbone of G5/A29 contacts the amino group. Compact ~34-nt fold; good test of narrow deep-pocket sampling.

enrichmentSets.description: PreQ1 riboswitch actives (deazaguanine analogs) vs property-matched decoys
enrichmentSets.source: Literature actives + RDKit property-matched decoys (Tanimoto<0.35 vs actives)
enrichmentSets.intendedUse: active-vs-decoy enrichment calibration for aptamer scoring terms

affinityNotes: preQ1 binds class III preQ1 riboswitch with Kd ~72 nM (Ferre-D'Amare group). PRF is a synthetic analog; exact Kd for PRF to 4RZD not published.
